hook.text: Pandas eat only bamboo. Koalas eat only eucalyptus. Specialists thrive—until their food disappears.

buildup.text: Hominins became generalists: fruit, leaves, insects, tubers, meat—whatever the environment offered.

discovery.text: Dietary flexibility let them survive climate swings that wiped out specialized feeders.

twist.text: Being an omnivore demands a bigger brain: you must learn what's edible, seasonal, and worth the effort.

climax.text: The cost of a flexible diet was cognitive. The payoff was surviving everywhere.

quiz.question: Why is being an omnivore an advantage?
